summary: The normalization bound and its depth consequence are proved without mathematical errors or gaps. The exponential upper bound sums every integer fiber, and the Hilbert-Schmidt cycle estimate applies to both parities of n. The specified Boolean fiber contains the claimed product region, including the two consecutive zero coordinates for odd n. The pushforward laws, moment bounds, rate selection, fixed-budget lower bound, and the separate parameter cases on both sides of b=1 are correct. The rational estimates give cJ/I at most 39/10, and the unmatched-coordinate factor and final exponential bound are valid uniformly for n>=100 and the stated k and beta. The compact full-dimensional body has positive finite total mixed volume, so equation (3) of the supplied accepted predecessor applies at the fixed center and cutoff zero, with a single point chosen before all closed ambient halfspaces.
